before: Wrapping a range that covered a complex field skipped the field's zero-width chrome (begin, instruction, separator, end), so the new content control held only the field result and cut the field in two.
after: wrapRangeInContentControl resolves each paragraph child by its atom span, as the caret-insert path already does, so a range over a field wraps every node the field is spelt with.
reason: The op still reduces to the same canonical tree primitives the journal replicates; only which existing children land under the new w:sdtContent changes. Released participants read the resulting shared state unchanged.
